verdict.rationale: Vonage's pricing page says new Video API customers get their first 100,000 minutes free and invites users to "try it for free" before pay-as-you-go. That is a free usage allowance large enough for development and early testing. missing for 10: details on the allowance's expiry and which features (e.g., archiving, SIP) count against it, independent or hands-on corroboration of the free-minutes offer

support.subject: As a founder, a free tier or free usage allowance covers development and early testing

citations.quote: The first 100,000 free minutes are available to new Vonage Video API customers.
Try it for free, pay as you go, and only then make a commitment
